translations.web: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
translations.bsb: After putting out from there, we sailed to the lee of Cyprus because the winds were against us.
translations.kjv: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
translations.asv: And putting to sea from thence, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
